topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found out that my partner has been writing a novel, and the main character, well, it's pretty clear who it's based on. I mean, I’m flattered, right? It’s just, I worry about the details. What parts of our life together did they feel compelled to put on paper? And what will others think, reading our story? I hope it doesn’t change how they see us, or us together. I guess I need to talk to them, but what do I say? I don’t want to hurt them, but I can’t ignore this either.
